subject: science
concept: Recognizing signs that a chemical reaction has occurred (bubbles, color change, temperature change, new smell)
source_inspiration: adapted from NGSS Physical Science Disciplinary Core Ideas (Chemical Reactions) — original content, not copied text

exercise.concrete: Student observes a simple safe reaction (e.g. baking soda and vinegar) and lists the signs a change occurred
exercise.pictorial: Student circles which of several pictured observations are true 'signs of reaction'
exercise.abstract: Student lists the reaction signs present in a described scenario

misconception_flags: mistakes a purely physical change (like stirring) for a chemical reaction sign

interest_binding: exercise regenerated using student's stated interest profile
